description: #[allow(clippy::large_enum_variant)] on TlsOrPlain in relay_client.rs silences a Clippy warning without explaining why boxing is not preferred. The enum has one small variant (Plain(TcpStream)) and one large variant (Tls(TlsStream<TcpStream>)). A comment should explain: TlsStream is not significantly larger than TcpStream in practice, and boxing would add a heap allocation per connection on the hot outbound delivery path — pin_project already handles the pin ergonomics. Without the comment a future contributor might cargo-clippy, see the suppressed warning, and 'fix' it by adding Box, adding an allocation on every SMTP connection.
title: TlsOrPlain large_enum_variant suppressed without explanation comment
